Package com.nexuslink.core.metrics

package com.nexuslink.core.metrics
  • Class
    Description
    MetricsAlerts
    Evaluates a MetricsCollector snapshot against configurable alerting thresholds and reports which channels breach them (high error rate or high tail/mean latency).
    MetricsAlerts.Alert
    One breach on one channel.
    MetricsAlerts.Kind
    What kind of threshold a channel breached.
    MetricsAlerts.Thresholds
    Alert limits.
    MetricsCollector
    Thread-safe, in-memory collector of per-channel request metrics — throughput, error rate, and latency percentiles — for the monitoring dashboard.
    MetricsCollector.Sample
    A single recorded request.
    MetricsCollector.Stats
    An immutable aggregate snapshot for one channel.
    MetricsReport
    Renders a MetricsCollector snapshot into a shareable, dependency-free report — CSV (for a spreadsheet) or JSON (for tooling).
